request.style: English, Southern gospel quartet, up-tempo with a walking bass singer, piano and banjo, the four voices trading lines and shouting together on the chorus, joyful country church, 128 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Early on the first day of the week
The women came to see the tomb
There was an earthquake and an angel came
And rolled the stone back from the room

[Chorus]
The stone is rolled away, the stone is rolled away
He is not here, he is risen as he said
Come and see the place where the Lord lay
The stone is rolled away

[Verse]
His face was like the lightning
His clothes were white as snow
The guards were shaking like dead men
Go tell his friends, it's so

[Chorus]
The stone is rolled away, the stone is rolled away
He is not here, he is risen as he said
Come and see the place where the Lord lay
The stone is rolled away
